questions.title: First Match With Break
questions.description: What does the following Ruby code print?

    result = x
    break
  end
end
puts result

questions.title: Nested Times Break Count
questions.description: What does the following Ruby code print?
questions.codesnippet:

5.times do |i|
  5.times do |j|
    break if j >= i
    count += 1
  end
end
puts count
